title: Service Account Tiers: Entry Conditions, Tier Review Figures and Closing Terms — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Service Accounts and Repair Orders** has six tiers. Entry conditions and the figures used at the annual tier review and at account closing:

| Tier | Who may hold it | Customer-pay spend needed at the annual review (USD) | Review window (months) | Unredeemed points forfeited on closing | Account closed only with nothing owed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Service Guest Account | An individual; no enrollment needed | 0.00 | 12 | Yes | Yes |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | An individual with a signed rewards enrollment | 0.00 | 12 | Yes | Yes |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Gold | An individual with a signed rewards enrollment whose rolling customer-pay spend meets the tier figure | 750.00 | 12 | Yes | Yes |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum | An individual with a signed rewards enrollment whose rolling customer-pay spend meets the tier figure | 2000.00 | 12 | Yes | Yes |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 | A fleet business with at least 3 registered fleet vehicles and an approved credit application | 0.00 | 12 | Yes | Yes |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | A fleet business with at least 10 registered fleet vehicles and an approved credit application | 0.00 | 12 | Yes | Yes |

The rolling customer-pay spend is the account's customer-pay labor and parts charges over the review window, less the credits that point at those charges.

**Hypothetical.** A rewards account whose rolling customer-pay spend at its review is 1430.00 meets the 750.00 figure but not the 2000.00 figure.
